refinement.why_necessary: Retrieved evidence shows NODI code 9 on FY2025 no-numeric-result rows partitions into two parameter families with materially different monitoring-obligation structures on the same permit (NM0020583). WET retest parameters (22415, 22416, 22418, 22419, 51443, 51444) are optional (OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=Y, frequency 09/99) and permit-labeled '(If required)'. Chlorine total residual (50060) is non-optional in structured limits (OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=N, frequency 01/01) but permit footnote *5 makes field monitoring conditional on chlorine use. A single uniform interpretation of NODI 9 across both families is not established by workspace text and would conflate conditional retest-not-required cases with conditional TRC-use cases.
